d: BIAMP Fixed I/O DSP with 12 analog inputs, 8 analog outputs, 8 channels configurable USB audio, 128 x 128 channels of AVB, and AEC technology (all 12 inputs)

specs.label: Audio
specs.value: Fixed I/O DSP with 12 analog inputs and 8 analog outputs and includes Acoustic Echo Cancellation (AEC) technology on all 12 inputs. It also includes up to 8 channels of configurable USB audio.

specs.value: USB: Bit Depth: 16- or 24-bit Number of Channels: up to 8 Sample Rate: 48kHz
